corpus_assessment.inclusion_rationale: Official proposed committee amendments in procedure 2021/0106(COD). Review of high-risk AI categories and horizontal implementation guidance. The compilation records a distinct part of the AI Act negotiating process.
corpus_assessment.researcher_notes: This is an independently citable compilation of proposed committee amendments 774 - 1189 -, not an adopted Parliament position or enacted amendment. The cover date is 13 June 2022. Official work/catalogue date 10 June 2022 is preserved as work-level metadata; it is not used as publication of the English PDF. The English PDF manifestation was formally issued 2022-06-21T13:16:23+02:00. Individual amendment sponsors are named in the PDF; the cover names rapporteurs for the underlying draft report, not authors of every amendment. The sponsor roster and concept annotations have not been exhaustively indexed; empty author/concept lists do not mean none.
